blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — The Cebu Provincial Development Council (PDC) has approved an additional ₱40 million for disaster preparedness and response, increasing the province’s proposed 2027 disaster risk reduction and management (DRRM) allocation from ₱400 million to ₱440 million. The funding amendment was approved during the PDC’s fourth-quarter meeting on Nov. 16, chaired by Gov. Pamela Baricuatro.
